title: Power Book II: Ghost Series Finale: Farewell to the Franchise
htmlContent:
Greetings, Power Book II: Ghost fans! We trust that tonight's episode 10, which has been officially confirmed as the series finale, was thoroughly enjoyed and savored by you. It’s a bittersweet moment for viewers, as this means no new episodes of “Ghost” will air in the future. Deadline.com reported that STARZ canceled 'Power Book II: Ghost' in March 2024, with STARZ CEO Jeffrey Hirsch explaining the decision. He mentioned that the show continued to run, increasing production costs and leading the network to reevaluate its budget.
“The longer the show kept running, the more expensive it got, and we need to cut costs,” Hirsch stated.
He elaborated on the network's future strategy:
“You look at the Power map and say, ‘OK, if I take one of those characters out and spin one of those out, I can bring that on to replace the Power show at half the cost.’
STARZ can maintain subscriber viewership through this shift while investing in new, less expensive shows. Hirsch emphasized the importance of understanding audience demographics and ensuring new content aligns with fans' desires. Even though 'Ghost' is over, there is still hope for the Power Universe. STARZ has announced a new prequel series with beloved characters Ghost and Tommy. In the future, fans can expect more action from this dynamic duo. Kathryn Busby, the President of Programming at STARZ, assured fans that the franchise will continue.
“This explosive season of Ghost is a fitting crescendo in a decade of an immensely popular franchise — fans will not be disappointed. While this marks the conclusion of one chapter, our commitment to the Power Universe endures with more compelling storytelling on the horizon.”
